## Selected Arm manual follow-through

Read the supplied `labs/architecture_ports_source/WALKER_MANUAL.md` with the original walker contract. Derive the actual corrected TCR, TTBR, MAIR and descriptor fields; explain the versioned disabled-TTBR1 correction and single-PE invalidation boundary. This source companion resolves the named selected-manual access omission while retaining the original implementation, rubric, delayed transfer and external evidence requirements. Only listed DDI0487H.a passages were inspected.
